ALSA: hda/realtek: Add a quirk for HP Pavilion 15z-ec200

Add the quirk for HP Pavilion Gaming laptop 15z-ec200 for
enabling the mute led. The fix apply the ALC285_FIXUP_HP_MUTE_LED
quirk for this model.
